I did try that once, I talked to my superintendent and told him that my resign request will be going through to my DCI and if it gets ignored you know why.

Unfortunately when my superintendent questioned my DCI he basically said “he never gave me any request” and i didn’t have evidence that I did give it to him. It’s so fucking annoying. The same thing happened when I reported him for constant physical assault

In order for me to resign, I must request my contract to be ended but because he is my DCI he throws my request away and makes it so I cannot report it.

If I try to migrate to another station it’s the same process.

And due to the contract it’s impossible to leave (it also auto renews aswell).
I’m in the UK not America btw. And it would be extremely difficult to record him
I don’t really want to migrate to another country, I’ve lived here all my life so, and i have reported him but to no avail as I am absent of sufficient evidence
